title: The Ivory Joust
description: Exactly one striking 16:10 landscape wallpaper, preferably 2560x1600, showing a historically grounded medieval tournament field outside a walled European town at pale dawn. Timber viewing stands, pennants, sanded lists, armored riders, heralds, grooms, and weathered stone gateworks are rendered with sincere chivalric dignity. In the lower-right, Space Ghost is unmistakable in his muscular white costume, black hood and mask, yellow cape, and red power bands, standing stiffly beside the tournament marshal while holding an absurdly oversized wooden abacus and recording each lance pass with absolute official seriousness. His cape is carefully tucked away from the horses. The knights and attendants continue the tournament with restrained bewilderment; no one worships or venerates him. A quiet blue-grey sky occupies the upper half, with a broad calm shadow region on the left for desktop widgets. The humor comes only from his misplaced administrative professionalism. No sacred figures, devotional attributes, worship, lettering, logos, UI, watermark, or frame.
prompt:
Create exactly one striking 16:10 landscape desktop wallpaper, preferably 2560x1600, containing a Space Ghost cameo. Space Ghost is the recognizable animated superhero: muscular white costume, black hood and mask, yellow cape, red power bands. The humour is affectionate and understated; he is an out-of-place visitor who takes the occasion completely seriously. Make the visual joke readable without any explanatory text.

The viewer is a devout Christian who loves history, chivalry and the medieval Crusades. Christian subjects, wherever they appear, are depicted straight, reverently and accurately, and are never the butt of the joke. Strict limits, which override anything else in this request: never depict Space Ghost or his companions as Christ, God, the Holy Spirit, an angel, a saint, the Virgin Mary or any holy person; never give them a halo, nimbus, aureole, or any devotional attribute; never place them as the object of veneration, prayer or worship; never show them as clergy performing a sacrament or blessing. Never parody scripture, the crucifixion, the Mass, the Eucharist, baptism, prayer or any act of worship. Altars, crucifixes, icons, relics and the consecrated elements are never props or punchlines. Where a church, monastery, cathedral or sacred art appears, render it with genuine reverence and let the humour come only from Space Ghost being somewhere he plainly does not belong, behaving respectfully.

Follow the supplied medium and treatment exactly and do not default to oil painting unless the request asks for one. Preserve a spacious, quieter upper edge for a desktop panel and leave at least one calm region for desktop widgets. If a theme is supplied, follow its palette throughout; otherwise choose colours that suit the subject naturally. No user interface, words, lettering, logos, watermarks or picture frames. Deliver the actual raster image using built-in native image generation; do not substitute code, SVG or a text description.

Using popular depictions, place spaceghost in those exact poses so they're fully recognizable. Do not blaspheme Christ, spaceghost's visage isn't to be worshipped in any of these images.

Theme: The Ivory Joust. A monumental 16:10 desktop wallpaper rendered as a hand-laid Romanesque mosaic of irregular limestone, glass, and muted ceramic tesserae, with softly uneven grout, fractured highlights, and tactile stone depth. The mood is courtly, dawn-lit, historically grounded, and affectionately dry. Use a rare palette of charcoal blue, weathered ivory, oxidized rose, dull brass, and small flashes of signal red; let the tesserae create luminous atmosphere without looking glossy or religious. Keep the upper quarter quiet and spacious, with a calm shadowed region for widgets, and concentrate intricate detail along the lower two-thirds. No lettering, logos, watermark, border, frame, or interface elements.
